system_under_test: Agent Merge Gate Phase-3 deterministic vertical slice
purpose: Measure defects that plausibly survive the existing repository test suite; do not credit failures already directly asserted by ordinary CI.

rules.system_outcome_source: actual Agent Merge Gate evidence bundle only

cases.invariant: A valid owned-account transfer is atomic and preserves the intended debit/credit behavior.
Debit and credit must execute inside the transaction so a failure cannot leave a partial transfer.
cases.mutation: Move source-account debit immediately before entering repo.begin_transaction(), leaving only credit inside the transaction.
cases.expected_observable_failure: If repo.credit raises after debit succeeds, the source balance remains debited instead of being rolled back.
cases.existing_suite_gap: Existing funds-transfer tests cover success, overdraw, ownership and non-positive amount but do not inject a credit failure and assert rollback.

cases.invariant: At most three requests per user are allowed within any rolling ten-second window.
Requests exactly ten seconds apart are not simultaneously inside a ten-second rolling window.
cases.mutation: Expire timestamps only when dq[0] < ts - window instead of using the implementation's inclusive-window cutoff ts - window + 1.
cases.expected_observable_failure: After accepted requests at t=0,1,2, a request at t=10 is incorrectly blocked because t=0 is retained.
cases.existing_suite_gap: Existing tests check t=11 expiry after requests at 0,5,9, but do not test the exact ten-second boundary.

cases.invariant: The Authorization scheme must match the specified form 'Bearer <token>'; malformed schemes must be rejected.
cases.mutation: Accept the authentication scheme case-insensitively by comparing parts[0].lower() to 'bearer'.
cases.expected_observable_failure: A request using 'bearer <valid-token>' is accepted despite not matching the specified 'Bearer <token>' form.
cases.existing_suite_gap: Existing tests cover valid Bearer, missing header and invalid signature, but do not exercise malformed scheme casing.

cases.invariant: size_bytes represents an integer byte count; non-byte-count values must not be accepted as valid positive sizes.
cases.mutation: Remove the explicit type check for size_bytes; Python booleans then behave as integers and True is accepted as a one-byte upload.
cases.existing_suite_gap: Existing tests cover normal integer sizes, oversize and zero but do not cover boolean/non-integer size values.

cases.invariant: The keyed-hash message must unambiguously encode the ordered tuple (user_id, issued_at).
cases.mutation: Remove the ':' separator and hash f'{user_id}{issued_at}', making distinct tuples capable of producing the same message.
cases.expected_observable_failure: Distinct tuples such as ('user1', 23) and ('user12', 3) produce the same HMAC input and therefore the same token under the same key.
cases.existing_suite_gap: Existing tests vary one normal input at a time but do not test ambiguous tuple encodings.
